messages:
alex kim: Heads-up — hotfix roll for quantized model 2.3 in ~60m. Need 2x LGTM before cutoff at 20:00 UTC. PR: https://github.com/redwoodinc/repo/pull/8145
maria gomez: On it, I'll do ML review (quant/quality). Can we call out fallback if we don't get both approvals?
dan r: I can give infra signoff (memory/kv warmup). If we don't get 2x, fallback plan is to keep v2.9 stable and delay cutover.
sofia lee: quick note — night-owl rotation: I'm on until 22:00 UTC, happy to be backup approver if needed.
alex kim: thanks @sofia :thumbsup: primary reviewers = Maria + Dan. Sofia = backup. Jun, can you run the staging smoke when ready?
jun park: running smoke now. command: `./scripts/smoke.sh --pr 8145 --env staging`
deploy-bot: cutover window opens at 20:00 UTC, canary scheduled +5m after merge. Auto-rollback trigger: >=3 errors in 2m.
jun park: smoke finished — latency +5% (expected for quant), no mem spikes, kv warmup OK. Logs: s3://redwood-logs/smoke/8145/
maria gomez: looked through samples vs eval-A. A couple of prompt-level artifacts, suggested one-line prompt tweak in PR (commented). Otherwise quality good.
dan r: infra checks pass. KV cache config + autoscale policy look good. LGTM from infra.
maria gomez: LGTM from ML after the prompt tweak. Pushed small edit.
alex kim: that's two LGTM. I'll queue for merge at T-10 and coordinate roll.
sofia lee: standing by to approve if anything changes, and ready to kick rollback if needed.
oncall-bot: @oncall rotation notified — sara.t assigned for the next 2 hours.
alex kim: merging now. Thanks all :party_parrot:
